name: Simple Chat Bot
author: SACHINRAJ CP

sections.description:
**Simple Chat Bot ** is an easy-to-use WordPress plugin that integrates a chatbot interface on your website, allowing visitors to connect with you instantly through WhatsApp. Enhance your customer support and engagement with this straightforward plugin.

Features include:
– Simple setup with no coding required.
– Customizable WhatsApp number for direct messaging.
– Responsive design that works on all devices.
– Option to display a chat interface for easy communication.

Keep your visitors engaged and provide them with instant support while you manage your website!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/Simple Chat bot directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Simple Chat Bot to configure your WhatsApp number and enable the chat feature.
sections.faq:
How do I set my WhatsApp number?

Go to Settings > Simple Chat Bot and enter your WhatsApp number in the designated field. Save your settings to activate the chat feature.

Can I customize the chat message content?

Yes, you can customize the chatbot messages within the settings page to suit your needs.

Will the chatbot be visible to all users?

Yes, the chatbot will be displayed to all visitors on your site, while logged-in users will still have full access to the website.

Is this plugin compatible with any theme?

Yes, Simple Chat Bot with WhatsApp Redirect works seamlessly with any WordPress theme.
